name: code-graph
description: Structural code navigation over MCP — tree-sitter symbol graph with resolved call, include, and inheritance edges for C++, Rust, Go, Python, C#, and Java. Answers where-is-it-defined, what-calls-it, what-depends-on-what, and what's-dead without reading files.

interface.shortDescription: Semantic code-graph MCP server for navigating large codebases
interface.longDescription: code-graph indexes a repository with tree-sitter into an in-memory semantic graph and exposes it over MCP — symbol search, call graphs, inheritance, file dependencies, cycles, orphans, and diagrams. Built for AI agents to navigate unfamiliar code without reading every file.
defaultPrompt: What does this file depend on?
Is there any dead code in this codebase?
